# D0001. Bun, Drizzle and Postgres, with a plain router and zod at every edge (2026-10-31)

**Status:** Active

**Chosen:** Bun runs the server (`Bun.serve`), the tests and the scripts. Postgres through postgres.js, with Drizzle for queries and migrations generated by drizzle-kit and committed. A small router of our own whose routes each declare their MCP exposure. zod validates the environment and every request body. One Docker image, deployed with Compose behind Caddy.

**Why:** One runtime for serving, testing and tooling keeps the commands few, and agents learn them once. Drizzle's queries are typed from the schema file and its migrations are plain SQL a reviewer can read. A router this small is easy to read in full, and the `mcp` field on each route makes "can an agent do this?" a test, not a review comment. Validating at the edge means handlers only ever see well-formed data, and failures name the field.

**Revisit if:** the app needs a web UI (add a framework then), routing outgrows one file per resource, or Postgres stops being the only store.
